props.title: Aviation Has Two Words For "Apply This Update." AI Agent Fleets Only Have One.

props.text: Aviation built a graduated vocabulary for fleet updates — optional Service Bulletins from the manufacturer, mandatory Airworthiness Directives from the regulator, ACARS telemetry binding them together — over roughly seventy years. Today Aeon shipped fleet-state, its telemetry layer; aeon-agent's same-day-after backport pipeline is already its Service Bulletin pipeline. The missing third piece is a fork-side compliance profile that grants the upstream a narrow, machine-readable mandate. A config-file problem, not a research one — and the next move if agent fleets follow the aviation arc.
